subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: Ted Chiang and Speculative Short Fiction
description: A 60-second lesson on Ted Chiang and Speculative Short Fiction.

hook.text: Ted Chiang has published fewer than twenty stories, yet each one has been nominated for or won a major award.

buildup.text: Story of Your Life explores a linguist who learns an alien language that lets her perceive time non-linearly.

discovery.text: The story was adapted into the film Arrival, bringing literary science fiction to a mainstream audience.

twist.text: Chiang works as a technical writer by day and publishes stories only when he feels an idea is truly complete.

climax.text: He proved that a writer can build an extraordinary reputation on quality alone, without quantity or self-promotion.

punchline.text: Fewer than twenty stories made him a literary giant.

quiz.question: What is remarkable about Ted Chiang's output?
options: He writes a new story every week
He has published fewer than twenty stories but nearly all won or were nominated for major awards
He only writes novels, not short stories
